fieldValues.title: Structured findings for record validate and container validate (srs-rust#1339 remainder)
fieldValues.decision_question: Where do the structured findings of `record validate` and `container validate` go, and who defines their codes?
fieldValues.context:
Problem: srs-rust#1339 has landed 13 additive slices (diagnosticsStructured beside the text list). Two surfaces remain: `record validate` (`RecordValidateReport.errors: Vec<String>`, record_store.rs) and `container validate` (container_service.rs), where typed ValidationErrors are flattened into strings. Their typed errors carry no stable code taxonomy yet, so a builder cannot add a Diagnostic {severity, code, message, instanceId?} without inventing codes and a payload shape, which is a contract ruling (decision 0b1c25b1).
Why it matters: editors (srs-web, srs-vscode) preflight a whole document with `record validate` and must branch on the failure kind; today they parse English. Until these two surfaces carry codes, issue #1339 cannot close and the text lists cannot be retired (#1496).
Options and consequences: (1) add `diagnosticsStructured` beside `errors` on both reports, same shape as the other thirteen slices (one way per goal, additive, needs a code taxonomy for ValidationError); (2) carry the findings in the ok:false envelope's `errors: [ErrorReport]` (ADR-053), which needs codes and details per ValidationError variant and changes where clients look; (3) do nothing, leaving the two surfaces text-only and #1339 open.
Recommendation: option 1.
Action needed: ratify option 1 and the rule that each ValidationError variant gets one kebab-case code, defined once in srs-repository.
Urgency: low; no client is blocked, the issue stays open and the group moves to other work.
fieldValues.friction: Every other payload on #1339 now carries diagnosticsStructured; these two cannot follow without a shape and code ruling, so the issue has been re-offered to the builder for many runs with nothing left that is inside the mandate (slice 13 report, 2026-11-14).
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: 1. Add diagnosticsStructured beside errors on RecordValidateReport and the container validate payload, with one kebab-case code per ValidationError variant (recommended). Opens: closing #1339, then #1496 retiring the text lists. Shuts: nothing, additive. Serves: one way per goal, clients branch on codes. 2. Carry findings in the ok:false envelope errors [ErrorReport] (ADR-053): no new field, but clients look in a second place and ErrorReport has no severity. Shuts: a warning-level finding. 3. Do nothing: two surfaces stay text-only, #1339 stays open and keeps being re-offered.
fieldValues.key_requirements: Codes defined once in srs-repository, stable, kebab-case, reusing names the validate-time rules already carry (for example container-pointer-unresolved). The text list stays unchanged until #1496. Payload goldens regenerated.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Add diagnosticsStructured beside the unchanged errors list on record validate and container validate, one kebab-case code per ValidationError variant, defined once in srs-repository.
fieldValues.rationale: It repeats the shape already shipped on thirteen surfaces (decision bf4a5af5), is additive and reversible, and keeps one place for clients to look.
fieldValues.revisit_when: ADR-053 ErrorReport gains a severity, or #1496 retires the text lists.
fieldValues.next_steps: On ratification the builder takes record validate and container validate as two slices, citing this decision as the ruling, and closes #1339.
